title: Summer English camp
text:
SUMMER ENGLISH CAMP by the lake in Masuria
For young people aged 12–16

Two weeks of English, sport and fun! 1–14 July or 15–28 July.

Every day:
- three hours of English lessons with native speakers (9:00–12:00)
- sports in the afternoon: sailing, kayaking, volleyball
- evening activities: films, games, a disco on Fridays

You sleep in wooden houses with four beds, and there are bathrooms in every house. We cook three healthy meals a day.

Price: 2,900 zł for two weeks. This includes lessons, food, the hotel and all sports. The bus from Warsaw costs 150 zł extra.

Book before 31 March and get 10% off!
Don't forget: you need a swimming certificate for sailing.

Call us: 600 123 456
